say:3:1810726002:1.text: You mock Bantus so lightly? Once you're in my hands, I'll carve open your chest myself to see where you get your nerve.
say:3:1810726002:1.source_cn: 竟敢挑衅班题斯？等抓住你们，我一定要剖开你的躯体看看你...

say:4:1810726005:1.text: This ends today. None of you will leave this place alive.
say:4:1810726005:1.source_cn: 今天就是你们的忌日——谁也别想逃！

choice:2:0:1.text: Then come and take it back.
choice:2:0:1.male: Then come and take it back.
choice:2:0:1.female: Then come and take it back.

say:6:1810726003:1.text: If you want to watch me use these living simpletons as shields, be my guest. Try it.
say:6:1810726003:1.source_cn: 只要你不怕我拿这些生者当肉盾，大可以试试。
say:6:1810726003:1.male: If you want to watch me use these living simpletons as shields, be my guest. Try it.

choice:2:1:2.text: Aren't you afraid I'll use it against you?

choice:2:2:3.text: This belongs to the God of Death. It's time it's returned.
